    Endpoint coefficient compiler for the bound BGRS Figure 15 source #

    The free Figure-15 quiver is thin, but its main length-three path is killed in the bound source. This file isolates the formal compiler needed after the finite coefficient table has been constructed. An endpoint coefficient is specified for every ordered pair of the eight source occurrences. Generator compatibility is stated after scaling by the landing path in the bound source, so every equation landing on the killed main path is automatic.

    The compiler iterates the two generator tables along arbitrary paths and produces the ThinQuotientPathCoefficientData used by the cross-universe Hom-bifunctor retraction.
